description:
A flask drawn straight off the Pool and stoppered where it stood, the colour of a bruise and warm through the glass. It has not stood, it has not settled and it has not been tested.

Wick Ollam will tell you exactly what it does to a person who drinks it at this stage, at length, without being asked, and she will not sell you one.
name: a raw draw

tags.description: Unsettled Pool water in a red-glazed jar. It is warm and it should not be.
